high_level_description: stc brand style, four Saudi colleagues collaborating around a wooden table in a warm-lit meeting room, working on laptops and a tablet.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern meeting room with vertical wood slat partitions, potted plants, and warm pendant lighting.

elements.desc: Two men wearing white thobes and red-and-white checkered ghutras, seated side by side working on laptops.
A woman wearing a purple abaya and matching hijab, leaning in and pointing at a tablet on the table.
A woman wearing a black abaya and black hijab, seated at the end of the table listening.
